_readme: Deployed environments the suite can target with TARGET=<name>. Add an environment by adding an entry here: no code change. The base URL is not stored here: set <NAME>_URL (e.g. UAT_URL) or TARGET_URL, or add an optional "url". Every other value is a per-environment default, and the env var of the same setting overrides it (CONTRACT_FILE, CAP_TRANSACTION_LISTING, IDEMPOTENCY_HEADER, REQUEST_ID_HEADER, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS). "nightly": true makes CI run the nightly suite and drift probe against it, using the GitHub environment of the same name for its URL and variables; "perf": true does the same for the nightly JMeter performance run (T2). Defaults describe the PUBLISHED contract: flip transactionListing and contractFile only once the provider has shipped the read path.
